_about: Public-domain Martin Wells Knapp, Methodist holiness evangelist and founder of God's Bible School in Cincinnati, for the Word Hoard: Christ Crowned Within, Out of Egypt into Canaan, Revival Tornadoes, Impressions, The Double Cure, Lightning Bolts from Pentecostal Skies, and The River of Death and its Branches. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 130 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

knapp-out-of-egypt: Out of Egypt into Canaan : or, Lessons in spiritual geography ([s.l. : s.n.], 1888)
knapp-revival-tornadoes: Revival tornadoes : or, life and labors of Rev. Joseph H. Weber, evangelist, the converted Roman Catholic (Boston, Mass. : McDonald, Gill ; Albion, Mich. : Revivalist Pub. Co., 1889)

knapp-river-of-death: The river of death and its branches (Cincinnati : M.W. Knapp, 1898)
